WITH labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN (customer_connected_time IS NULL OR trim(customer_connected_time) = '') AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, '')) = '' AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_name, '')) = '' THEN 'No Answer' WHEN (customer_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND trim(customer_connected_time) != '') AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, '')) = '' AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_name, '')) = '' THEN 'Ended Without Disposition' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(disposition_analyzer), ''), NULLIF(trim(disposition_name), ''), 'Unknown') END AS disposition_analyzer,
    customer_to_speech_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN speech_detected_end IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_end != ''
       AND agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      THEN (julianday(agent_connected_time) - julianday(speech_detected_end)) * 86400.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS disposition_to_agent_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN customer_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND customer_connected_time != ''
       AND conversation_end IS NOT NULL AND conversation_end != ''
      THEN (julianday(conversation_end) - julianday(customer_connected_time)) * 86400.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS connected_duration_seconds
  FROM conversations
  WHERE campaign_id = $campaign
),
connected_ranked AS (
  SELECT disposition_analyzer, connected_duration_seconds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY disposition_analyzer ORDER BY connected_duration_seconds) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY disposition_analyzer) AS cnt
  FROM labeled
  WHERE connected_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND connected_duration_seconds >= 0
),
connected_pct AS (
  SELECT disposition_analyzer,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.90 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_duration_seconds END), 3) AS p90_connected_duration_seconds,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.95 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_duration_seconds END), 3) AS p95_connected_duration_seconds,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.99 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_duration_seconds END), 3) AS p99_connected_duration_seconds
  FROM connected_ranked
  GROUP BY disposition_analyzer
),
agg AS (
  SELECT disposition_analyzer,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percent_total,
    ROUND(AVG(customer_to_speech_seconds), 3) AS avg_customer_to_speech_seconds,
    ROUND(AVG(disposition_to_agent_seconds), 3) AS avg_disposition_to_agent_seconds,
    ROUND(AVG(connected_duration_seconds), 3) AS avg_connected_duration_seconds
  FROM labeled
  GROUP BY disposition_analyzer
)
SELECT a.disposition_analyzer, a.count, a.percent_total,
  a.avg_customer_to_speech_seconds, a.avg_disposition_to_agent_seconds,
  a.avg_connected_duration_seconds,
  c.p90_connected_duration_seconds, c.p95_connected_duration_seconds, c.p99_connected_duration_seconds
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN connected_pct c ON a.disposition_analyzer = c.disposition_analyzer
ORDER BY a.count DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT date,
    CASE
      WHEN speech_detected_end IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_end != ''
       AND agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      THEN (julianday(agent_connected_time) - julianday(speech_detected_end)) * 86400.0

    AND date IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT date, seconds
  FROM base
  WHERE seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND seconds >= 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT date, seconds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY seconds) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY date) AS cnt
  FROM filtered
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT date,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.95 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN seconds END), 2) AS p95_seconds,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.99 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN seconds END), 2) AS p99_seconds
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY date
),
agg AS (
  SELECT date, ROUND(AVG(seconds), 2) AS avg_seconds
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT a.date, a.avg_seconds, p.p95_seconds, p.p99_seconds
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN percentiles p ON a.date = p.date

    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dominant_latency_stage), ''), 'Unknown') AS stage,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base), 2) AS pct
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    2 AS sort_order,
    band_sort,
    'Compliance Summary' AS section,
    metric,
    NULL AS count,
    pct,
    detail
  FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS band_sort, 'Pct calls in 0-2 sec band' AS metric,
      ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delay_band = '0-2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / MAX(dt.n), 2) AS pct,
      'disposition\u2192agent or disposition\u2192abandon (speech_detected_end anchor)' AS detail
    FROM base CROSS JOIN delay_totals dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Pct calls in 20+ sec band',
      ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delay_band = '20+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / MAX(dt.n), 2),
      'disposition\u2192agent or disposition\u2192abandon (speech_detected_end anchor)'
    FROM base CROSS JOIN delay_totals dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Dominant delay stage',
      (SELECT pct FROM dominant),
      (SELECT stage FROM dominant)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Avg disposition-to-agent time (sec)',
      ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN delay_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN delay_seconds END), 2),
      'compliance delay_seconds among banded calls'
    FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'Avg dial-to-customer time (sec)',
      ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dial_to_customer_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN dial_to_customer_seconds END), 2),
      'among calls with timestamp'
    FROM base
  )
)
SELECT section, metric, count, pct, detail, sort_order
FROM (
  SELECT sort_order, band_sort, section, metric, count, pct, detail FROM delay_bands
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sort_order, band_sort, section, metric, count, pct, detail FROM summary
)
ORDER BY sort_order, band_sort, metric

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    lower(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, disposition_name, '')) AS disp,
    disposition_analyzer,
    disposition_name,
    speech_detected_start,
    speech_detected_end,
    acd_offer_time,
    agent_alert_time,
    agent_connected_time,
    conversation_duration_seconds,
    delay_band,
    dial_to_customer_seconds,
    customer_to_speech_seconds,
    has_conference,
    customer_connected_time,
    conversation_end,
    CASE
      WHEN speech_detected_end IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_end != ''
       AND agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      THEN (julianday(agent_connected_time) - julianday(speech_detected_end)) * 86400.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS disposition_to_agent_seconds
  FROM conversations
  WHERE campaign_id = $campaign
),
disp_ranked AS (
  SELECT disposition_to_agent_seconds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY disposition_to_agent_seconds) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM base
  WHERE disposition_to_agent_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND disposition_to_agent_seconds >= 0
),
disp_pct AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.95 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN disposition_to_agent_seconds END), 3) AS p95_disposition_to_agent,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.99 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN disposition_to_agent_seconds END), 3) AS p99_disposition_to_agent
  FROM disp_ranked
),
ewd_connected_ranked AS (
  SELECT connected_sec,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY connected_sec) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT (julianday(conversation_end) - julianday(customer_connected_time)) * 86400.0 AS connected_sec
    FROM base
    WHERE trim(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, '')) = '' AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_name, '')) = ''
      AND customer_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND customer_connected_time != ''
      AND conversation_end IS NOT NULL AND conversation_end != ''
  )
  WHERE connected_sec IS NOT NULL AND connected_sec >= 0
),
ewd_connected_pct AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(connected_sec), 3) AS avg_ended_without_disposition_connected,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.90 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_sec END), 3) AS p90_ended_without_disposition_connected,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.95 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_sec END), 3) AS p95_ended_without_disposition_connected,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.99 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connected_sec END), 3) AS p99_ended_without_disposition_connected
  FROM ewd_connected_ranked
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS interactions,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN disposition_to_agent_seconds >= 0 THEN disposition_to_agent_seconds END), 3) AS avg_disposition_to_agent,
    ROUND(AVG(customer_to_speech_seconds), 3) AS avg_customer_to_speech,
    ROUND(AVG(conversation_duration_seconds), 3) AS avg_conversation_duration,
    SUM(CASE WHEN speech_detected_start IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_start != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected,
    SUM(CASE WHEN disp = 'speech.person' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rpc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      AND acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_connected,
    SUM(CASE WHEN disp = 'speech.machine' OR disp LIKE 'recording.machine%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS machine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND trim(customer_connected_time) != '' AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, '')) = '' AND trim(COALESCE(disposition_name, '')) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ended_without_disposition,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_connected_time IS NULL OR trim(customer_connected_time) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_answer,
    SUM(CASE WHEN agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      AND acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != ''
      AND IFNULL(conversation_duration_seconds, 0) >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conv_30s,
    SUM(CASE WHEN disp LIKE 'recording.ivr.callscreener%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS call_screener,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != ''
      AND (disp = 'speech.person' OR disp LIKE 'recording.ivr.callscreener%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transferred,
    SUM(CASE WHEN agent_alert_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_alert_time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agent_alerted,
    SUM(CASE WHEN acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != ''
      AND (agent_connected_time IS NULL OR agent_connected_time = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandon_acd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
      AND acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != ''
      AND IFNULL(conversation_duration_seconds, 0) >= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conv_2min,
    SUM(CASE WHEN delay_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delay_band_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN delay_band = '0-2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delay_0_2,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dial_to_customer_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN dial_to_customer_seconds END), 3) AS avg_dial_to_customer,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(has_conference) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conference
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  interactions,
  avg_disposition_to_agent,
  avg_customer_to_speech,
  avg_conversation_duration,
  (SELECT p95_disposition_to_agent FROM disp_pct) AS p95_disposition_to_agent,
  (SELECT p99_disposition_to_agent FROM disp_pct) AS p99_disposition_to_agent,
  ROUND(100.0 * connected / interactions, 2) AS connect_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * rpc / interactions, 2) AS rpc_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * agent_connected / interactions, 2) AS agent_connect_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * machine / interactions, 2) AS machine_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * no_answer / interactions, 2) AS no_answer_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * ended_without_disposition / interactions, 2) AS ended_without_disposition_rate,
  (SELECT avg_ended_without_disposition_connected FROM ewd_connected_pct) AS avg_ended_without_disposition_connected,
  (SELECT p90_ended_without_disposition_connected FROM ewd_connected_pct) AS p90_ended_without_disposition_connected,
  (SELECT p95_ended_without_disposition_connected FROM ewd_connected_pct) AS p95_ended_without_disposition_connected,
  (SELECT p99_ended_without_disposition_connected FROM ewd_connected_pct) AS p99_ended_without_disposition_connected,
  ROUND(100.0 * conv_30s / interactions, 2) AS conversation_30s_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * call_screener / interactions, 2) AS call_screener_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * transferred / interactions, 2) AS transfer_rate,
  CASE WHEN agent_alerted > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * agent_connected / agent_alerted, 2) END AS agent_pickup_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * abandon_acd / interactions, 2) AS abandon_acd_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * conv_2min / interactions, 2) AS conversation_2min_rate,
  CASE WHEN delay_band_n > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * delay_0_2 / delay_band_n, 2) END AS pct_delay_0_2,
  avg_dial_to_customer,
  ROUND(100.0 * conference / interactions, 2) AS conference_rate
FROM agg

  FROM conversations

),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT date,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.95 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN seconds END), 2) AS p95_seconds,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.99 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN seconds END), 2) AS p99_seconds
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY date
),
agg AS (
  SELECT date, ROUND(AVG(seconds), 2) AS avg_seconds
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT a.date, a.avg_seconds, p.p95_seconds, p.p99_seconds
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN percentiles p ON a.date = p.date
ORDER BY a.date

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT
    (julianday(agent_connected_time) - julianday(customer_connected_time)) * 86400.0 AS total_seconds,
    (julianday(speech_detected_start) - julianday(customer_connected_time)) * 86400.0 AS connect_to_speech_start,
    (julianday(speech_detected_end) - julianday(speech_detected_start)) * 86400.0 AS speech_start_to_disposition,
    (julianday(speech_detected_end) - julianday(customer_connected_time)) * 86400.0 AS connect_to_disposition,
    (julianday(ivr_start_time) - julianday(speech_detected_end)) * 86400.0 AS disposition_to_ivr,
    (julianday(acd_offer_time) - julianday(ivr_start_time)) * 86400.0 AS ivr_to_queue,
    (julianday(agent_alert_time) - julianday(acd_offer_time)) * 86400.0 AS queue_to_alert,
    (julianday(agent_connected_time) - julianday(agent_alert_time)) * 86400.0 AS alert_to_agent
  FROM conversations
  WHERE campaign_id = $campaign
    AND lower(COALESCE(disposition_analyzer, disposition_name, '')) = 'speech.person'
    AND customer_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND customer_connected_time != ''
    AND speech_detected_start IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_start != ''
    AND speech_detected_end IS NOT NULL AND speech_detected_end != ''
    AND ivr_start_time IS NOT NULL AND ivr_start_time != ''
    AND acd_offer_time IS NOT NULL AND acd_offer_time != ''
    AND agent_alert_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_alert_time != ''
    AND agent_connected_time IS NOT NULL AND agent_connected_time != ''
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM seg
  WHERE total_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND total_seconds >= 0
    AND connect_to_speech_start >= 0
    AND speech_start_to_disposition >= 0
    AND connect_to_disposition >= 0
    AND disposition_to_ivr >= 0
    AND ivr_to_queue >= 0
    AND queue_to_alert >= 0
    AND alert_to_agent >= 0
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS call_count,
    ROUND(AVG(total_seconds), 3) AS avg_total,
    ROUND(AVG(connect_to_speech_start), 3) AS avg_connect_to_speech_start,
    ROUND(AVG(speech_start_to_disposition), 3) AS avg_speech_start_to_disposition,
    ROUND(AVG(connect_to_disposition), 3) AS avg_connect_to_disposition,
    ROUND(AVG(disposition_to_ivr), 3) AS avg_disposition_to_ivr,
    ROUND(AVG(ivr_to_queue), 3) AS avg_ivr_to_queue,
    ROUND(AVG(queue_to_alert), 3) AS avg_queue_to_alert,
    ROUND(AVG(alert_to_agent), 3) AS avg_alert_to_agent
  FROM filtered
),
p90_connect_speech AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN connect_to_speech_start END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT connect_to_speech_start,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY connect_to_speech_start) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
),
p90_speech_window AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN speech_start_to_disposition END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT speech_start_to_disposition,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY speech_start_to_disposition) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
),
p90_disp_ivr AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN disposition_to_ivr END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT disposition_to_ivr,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY disposition_to_ivr) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
),
p90_ivr_queue AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN ivr_to_queue END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT ivr_to_queue,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ivr_to_queue) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
),
p90_queue_alert AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN queue_to_alert END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT queue_to_alert,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY queue_to_alert) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
),
p90_alert_agent AS (
  SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = MAX(1, CAST((cnt - 1) * 0.9 + 1 AS INTEGER)) THEN alert_to_agent END), 3) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT alert_to_agent,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY alert_to_agent) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM filtered
  )
)
SELECT
  agg.*,
  p90_connect_speech.v AS p90_connect_to_speech_start,
  p90_speech_window.v AS p90_speech_start_to_disposition,
  p90_disp_ivr.v AS p90_disposition_to_ivr,
  p90_ivr_queue.v AS p90_ivr_to_queue,
  p90_queue_alert.v AS p90_queue_to_alert,
  p90_alert_agent.v AS p90_alert_to_agent
FROM agg
CROSS JOIN p90_connect_speech
CROSS JOIN p90_speech_window
CROSS JOIN p90_disp_ivr
CROSS JOIN p90_ivr_queue
CROSS JOIN p90_queue_alert
CROSS JOIN p90_alert_agent
